name: Squallwing Drake
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 120 ft.; Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The drake makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Thunder Line.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Thunder Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Thunder damage. *Success:* Half damage.

Actions.name: Thunder Line
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 18 (4d8) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the drake, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.clause: The drake looses a rolling wall of thunder that sweeps low across the ground in a line; each creature that fails the sav
Actions.expressedQuote: the target is pushed up to 10 feet straight away from the drake

lore: Hatched in the roiling thunderheads of a storm-wracked peak, this young drake rides the squall-line down from its eyrie to prove its growing power by flattening anything that dares stand in the open.
